lists.description: For each screen whose up-front list should change, the facts to read up front there besides the core ones, most useful first. A screen left out keeps the list it has. Only screens that are in the report; only facts that are on the catalogue and not core. An empty list takes every extra fact off that screen.

reasons.description: One plain sentence for each change in `lists`, saying what in the counts made it, for him to read in About. When nothing changes, one sentence saying so.

misses_worth_a_story.description: Misses in the report that are worth building something for: asked for more than once, or by the same screen over and over. Each names the screen and the miss's `name` exactly as the report has them, so the app can count it. Leave the list out when no miss is worth a story.

title.description: What to build, as a story's title.

why.description: Why it is worth building: what he wanted, how often, what the app lacks.

asks.description: Names of facts on the catalogue (is fact) that you need before you can decide well. The app reads them and sends the request again with them as asked; ask once, for everything you need. Leave it out when the report is enough.
